items.text: Both macOS and iOS inventories have zero forbidden references and empty exception lists. The exported-API checker still rejects failing or incomplete dumps and initializer, result, property and nested-type leak fixtures. External clients read business snapshots; both the WebSocket-URL and CachedTask probes fail for the intended compiler diagnostic.

Run scripts/check-layers and scripts/check-layers-test against actual SwiftPM dependencies, source imports and Xcode targets. Verify no business target imports a foundation target, the widget only links DSHActivity and Release excludes fake and debug code.

Run scripts/swift-test --package-path ios/DSHKit, the iOS simulator build, scripts/check-release-clean and scripts/check-docs. ARCHITECTURE.md describes the merged graph. Distinguish changes from failures already recorded at 61b5416.

The new iOS app against the bridge at 61b5416 completes Hello, Resume, ListTasks, approval and queue operations with negotiated capabilities. Verify the same-install offline/reconnect and revocation regression tests still pass.
